purpose: A body cell that leads with a thumbnail at 1:1 or 2:1, with an optional label and description, for rows about products, people or files.

notFor.case: Not for standalone use outside a table row.
A text cell, or one with a small Avatar or Checkbox in its leading slot.

Default.visual: The thumbnail; label in Content/primary (Type/body-sm), description in Content/secondary (Type/helper).

notes: The image needs alt text, or alt="" when the label already names it.

openQuestions: Motion: State Default · Disabled has no motion decision in the contract (finding MOT-002 TableMediaCell). Confirm the cell needs none.
Disabled dims the text only; should the thumbnail dim too?
